name: Randgold & Exploration Company Limited
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer summarised group unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026, statement of profit or loss, unit R thousands multiplied by 1,000 to match the absolute rand columns. The group is a single segment investment holding company with no revenue line, so Revenue is zero as in the annual columns and Cost of Sales and Gross Profit stay empty. Operating Expenses is personnel expenses 5134 plus other operating expenses 3966 less the net change in fair value of investments in securities of 31, which is the printed loss from operating activities of 9069. Net Finance Costs is the finance income of 1523 shown as a negative net cost. Loss from operating activities of 9069 plus finance income 1523 equals the printed loss before taxation of 7546, no taxation was recognised, and the loss for the period is 7546. EPS is the printed basic and diluted loss per share of 10.54 cents converted to rand. Balance sheet ratios are left empty because a half year ratio is not comparable with the annual columns. || CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard). The resolved file's own value wins wherever the two disagreed, and every such disagreement is recorded in _alias_sync_20261120_0440.json. | Randgold & Exploration Company Limited notice of annual general meeting and summarised group financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (https://randgoldexp.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Randgold-Exploration-Company-Ltd-Notice-of-the-AGM-13-May-2026.pdf), summarised group statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 17, audited by KPMG Inc. with an unmodified opinion. Figures in rand thousands, stored in absolute rand. Revenue is nil in both years, as the statement prints. Operating Expenses FY2025 14 877 is personnel expenses 10 090 plus other operating expenses 7 084 less the 2 297 change in fair value of investments in securities, and FY2024 17 175 is 10 063 plus 9 465 less 2 353, because the fixed label set has no row for the fair value movement; that makes Operating Profit (EBIT) equal the statement's loss from operating activities, and EBIT plus finance income 3 713 (2024: 5 091) equals the loss before taxation exactly. Taxation is nil. EPS is the basic and diluted loss per share printed in cents, converted to rand per share: 15.60 cents for 2025 and 16.88 cents for 2024. The earlier FY2025 and FY2024 operating figures of 17 174 000 and 19 528 000 were the gross expense lines and are replaced. Read 2026-11-11.
